notes.title: Version 1.0.1 Update
notes.notes:
Hello krill army, our krengineers have been hard at work behind the scenes to bring you a kloriously krimproved krillsperience:

Gameplay


The golden crown now gets awarded after each encounter that the player has a combo rank at or above an A.
The paper crown now gets awarded only when the krill are really disappointed, rather than at just a mediocre combo score. (Hint hint nudge nudge)


Bug Fixes


The krill swarm no longer tries to set it's direction vector to zero.
Fixed a potential krill behavior issue regarding null data causing the compute shader to fail.
Fixed a material property interpolation issue for certain materials that didn't have specific properties.
Stopped the level music from playing on the main menu after losing and then regaining focus.
Fixed an issue in the case a Steam achievement can't be awarded was handled.
Fixed the tutorial enemy not spawning after the first time the player passed through the tutorial area.


Steam Achievements


Disallowed the secret "How? For what purpose?" achievement being mistakenly awarded in certain circumstances.
Fixed the secret "How? For what purpose?" achievement from never being awarded unless mistakenly from the issue above.
Players can no longer get the achievements related to completing the game just by watching the credits.


The King,
Krilliam
